balance.description: Current balance of the account, as a number or a string with up to 4 decimal places.

balance_as_of.description: Date or datetime the balance is as of: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time.

closed_on.description: Date the account was closed: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 date-time. Requires status to be closed.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. usd (defaults to primary currency). Uppercase input is lowercased.

custom_metadata.description: Optional JSON object with additional data about the account. Pass null to clear it on update.

display_name.description: Display name. If omitted or null, derived from institution_name and name. An explicitly set display name must be unique.

exclude_from_transactions.description: If true, transactions cannot be assigned to this account.

external_id.description: Optional user-defined ID for the account (max 75 characters).

institution_name.description: Name of the institution holding the account. Omit or pass null for none.

status.description: Status of the account. Defaults to active. Must be closed when closed_on is set.

subtype.description: Optional subtype (e.g., retirement, checking, savings). Omit or pass null for none.

type.description: Primary type of the manual account.
